Name: Seasonal Path and Flooring
Author: DustBeauty
Description:
. Option to toggle true/false for the swimming pool as the gravel path.
. Including matching thumbnails so it won't confuse you which one is which.
. The petals and fallen leaves only apply on the corners of each path, It won't look this excessive while covering larger areas.

Seasonal fences available here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4870]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4870
[/url][b]The map is made by me, edited based on Hidden Spirit Cove Farm, included in an upcoming story expansion mod.[/b]

Credit [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/607]Eemie[/url] for the original design of crystal path and crystal floor.
Credit [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51]Yunix93[/url] for a more natural-looking gravel path.
The pool idea was inspired by [url=https://cafe.naver.com/starvall/106406]movin[/url]﻿ on naver,
